title: Nearby Duplicate
statement:
A camera logs a number each second in `readings`. A repeat is **suspicious** if the same number appears at two different positions that are at most `k` apart.

Return `true` if there are two positions `i != j` with `readings[i] == readings[j]` and `|i - j| <= k`, otherwise `false`.

examples.explanation: The 1s are at positions 0 and 3, which are 3 apart.
Equal numbers are always 3 apart, which is more than 2.

hints.nudge: When you see a number, what single piece of information about its last appearance is enough?
hints.pattern: Hash map from value to its most recent index.
hints.walkthrough: Comparing every pair within distance k costs O(n*k). Scan once and remember, for each value, the index where you last saw it. If the current value was seen before and the gap i - last is at most k, you found a suspicious repeat. Otherwise update the last index to i (only the closest earlier copy matters). O(n) time.
